modifications: Ported the reduced-output-row concept to an adapter-owned MLX module for affine-quantized or float heads; no vLLM or CUDA/Marlin code copied.
Added exact artifact binding for the id list, its retained license file, and the model config, weight index, and tokenizer.
Kept ordinary target logits and verification full-vocabulary and added a capability-based full-head bypass for any batched lane with logits processors.
Left the mechanism default-off and exposed separate selected and observed-use diagnostics.
Added a CPU-only manifest builder, a non-executing A/B plan generator, an isolated same-load GPU A/B harness, and a teacher-forced divergence analyzer.
validation: CPU-only manifest binding, full-slice identity, reduced-slice -inf scatter, constrained-request bypass, policy, and rejection-law tests.
GPU smoke and counterbalanced same-load A/B on Apple M5 Max with MLX 0.32.2.dev20260919+39400a0d4; raw receipts are under qualification/runs/mtp-draft-vocab-20260929/.
The candidate was observed used, the constrained-request full-head bypass was observed used, and timed A/B rounds incurred zero swapout growth.
Median paired throughput changed by +3.43% at B1, -0.92% at B4, and -0.84% at B8; therefore the feature remains default-off and is not selected for production.

Exact greedy parity passed at B1 and B8. B4 diverged at one repeated near-tie: the reduced arm selected the teacher-forced full-target argmax by a 0.125-logit margin while the control selected the runner-up; this still fails the exact-token qualification gate.
